newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up on institutional buying.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up on institutional buying.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher on buying by both retail and institutional investors, brokers said.

"There were more buyers than sellers in the market today. The scrips were very attractive to the small investors. The investors returned with fresh commitments," said broker Mohammad Ullah. Eastern Cables gained 8.25 taka to 326.84, BOC Bangladesh rose 1.85 to 161.03 and Beximco Denims was up 5.86 to 177.84.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index rose 21.96 points or 2.34 percent at 957.48 on a turnover of 55.1 million taka. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
